limits: Storage diagnostics do not establish calibrated physical albedo, visible colour, local chemistry, terrain or photometric accuracy.
Publisher relative albedo average1 range0–2 and unitless label retained; older assessment Radius(meters) legend conflict remains explicit.
ISIS special-pixel interpretation, map frame/product association, source filters/UTC and redistribution terms remain open. No angular/raster geometry calculation.
No native replacement, source resampling, model/map adoption, dossier, catalogue or codec change. Full source bytes retained unchanged.
Published projection sphere106500m,301.26023555494m/pixel and6.17pixels/degree are header conventions, not newly calculated physical radius or raster geometry.
Planetocentric PositiveEast mapping is not transferred to NASA3D without product/pixel identity.
2022 processing timestamps have no explicit timezone and are not observation dates;2023 label publication remains separate.
Referenced NETCDF phoebe_albedo.nc and smp180.map not acquired or reproduced.
Relative albedo is not calibrated visible colour, terrain, local chemistry or independently validated photometry.
No replacement, resampling of native source, embedding, dossier, catalogue or codec change.
All2468642 stored values are finite and within0–2; this does not independently reproduce the publisher average1 normalization or establish special-pixel semantics.
Earlier assessment page7 relative-albedo title/caption versus Radius(meters) legend remains an unresolved publisher inconsistency.
Redistribution terms, original NETCDF/map, raw UTC/filter association and independent photometric validation remain open.
